issue_request: FHIR-41452 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core R6 clarification asking to clarify when breaking changes are allowed to normative content and pointing directly to HL7/fhir PR #2944.

additional_context: Earlier same-page issues FHIR-38876 and FHIR-40494 established the surrounding inter-version compatibility framing. Later FHIR-51051 altered the datatype row but did not change the FHIR-41452 clarification. FHIR-54807 is a later Submitted ballot-intro conflict report, not a final source decision for this page.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/versions.html already defines general change kinds, separates Trial Use from Normative behavior, and states that rare technical breaks to Normative content require broad notification, community consultation, and multiple HL7 governance reviews.
